milestone: independent-account commerce app path over local relay

environment.execution: isolated source snapshot of the staged index with node_modules linked; .grok excluded; disposable loopback NIP-01 relay, local watcher, and synthetic wallet RPC

coverage: Restored distinct synthetic buyer and vendor Nostr accounts in separate Chromium contexts.
Buyer order request and vendor address-issued update traveled through the existing browser NIP-44/NIP-59 app path and were received by the other account over the local relay.
Vendor paymentWatch.checkPayment accepted the actual local watcher handler's signed v2 report for one synthetic incoming Monero transfer.
Vendor's confirmed update was delivered back to and received by the buyer.
The three outer kind-1059 events were retained by the local relay and did not expose the order title as plaintext.
Watcher preflight and report read succeeded; the derived child token was in Authorization and absent from the request URL.

limits: Accounts, wallet RPC response, transfer, and transaction identifier are synthetic; no chain or wallet-daemon evidence.
The harness exercises app DM APIs for order payloads rather than clicking buyer/vendor commerce UI, and it does not create or verify the vendor receipt-ledger entry.
Relay and watcher are local test services; no deployed operator setup or public-relay test.
This does not change or migrate production DMs and is not a commerce release decision.
